title: Russell Targ saw real miracles while working as a stage magician

tellings.quote: Russell Tar actually mentioned this too that like in his younger days he was a stage magician and would experience actual miracles

plain: Russell Targ, a researcher, is said to have worked as a stage magician when he was young and to have seen "actual miracles" happen during that time, beyond the tricks. The magician Chris Ramsay tells this as something Targ himself mentioned, as a hint that real wonders can show up alongside stage illusion.
